answer: A concrete sybil brake is stake-weighted identity with bonded challenge windows: each agent must lock a cedar-denominated bond before minting a fresh persona. Attestation peers mirror that bond against on-ledger history and reject clones whose parent graph is too shallow. Graders forge a cost curve where spawning N identities multiplies lockup and grading risk linearly, so an attacker pays capital plus slash risk per fake, not just API calls.
